name: HubSpot Inactive Deal Revival Engine (Stalled stage + rep task + re-engagement sequence)

nodes.name: Weekday Pipeline Scan (Cron)
nodes.notes: Mon-Fri 07:40 (n8n instance timezone). Adjust to your sales calendar.

nodes.name: Load Config
nodes.notes: Validates every variable and fails fast. No secrets are read here (the HubSpot token lives in the n8n credential).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Search Inactive Deals
nodes.notes: [sandbox-safe] Read-only CRM Search: open deals in scope with no logged call/email/meeting (notes_last_contacted) before the cutoff, or never contacted and created before it.

nodes.name: Validate Inactivity Thresholds
nodes.notes: Re-checks every threshold in code (defence in depth) and caps the batch at MAX_DEALS_PER_RUN.

nodes.name: Loop Over Stalled Deals
nodes.notes: One deal per iteration. Every branch returns an outcome record to this node; "done" emits them all to Run Telemetry.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Get Deal Contacts
nodes.notes: [sandbox-safe] Read-only (v4 associations, includes association labels for primary-contact selection).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Read Contacts
nodes.notes: [sandbox-safe] Read-only batch read. Opted-out or already-enrolled contacts are never enrolled.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Get Deal Owner
nodes.notes: [sandbox-safe] Read-only. Provides userId + email required by the Sequences API. Missing/archived owners fall back to FALLBACK_OWNER_ID for the task.

nodes.name: Live Mode?
nodes.notes: [sandbox-gate:live-output=0] Fail-safe: only the exact value "live" reaches the stage update, task and enrollment.

nodes.name: Record Dry-Run Outcome
nodes.notes: Sandbox: nothing is written; the planned actions are reported in Run Telemetry.

nodes.name: Assert Live Mode
nodes.notes: Defense in depth: re-reads SANDBOX_MODE before any CRM write.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Move Deal to Stalled
nodes.notes: Sets dealstage to the pipeline's Stalled stage (+ optional previous-stage / stalled-at properties). Runs first: if it fails, no task or enrollment happens.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Create Rep Task
nodes.notes: Follow-up task for the deal owner (or FALLBACK_OWNER_ID), associated to the deal (216) and the primary contact (204).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Enroll Primary Contact
nodes.notes: Sequences API: POST /automation/v4/sequences/enrollments?userId=<owner userId> with sequenceId, contactId, senderEmail (owner's connected inbox). Requires a Sales/Service Hub seat with sequences.

nodes.name: Run Telemetry
nodes.notes: Final run report in the execution log: counts, per-deal statuses, masked emails. No deal amounts or contact names.
